summary: 3D rhythm march with an Ottoman mehter band on a parade avenue, built by Claude Haiku 5.5 · Osmanlı alay caddesinde mehter takımıyla 3D ritim yürüyüşü, Claude Haiku 5.5 yaptı
key_features: Four lanes for davul, kös, zurna and zil on D F J K or touch; long zurna notes are held to the end
Six songs from 96 to 176 BPM, each in Easy, Normal and Hard, generated from usul rhythm patterns
Music scheduled on the audio clock, hits judged against it, with an input-offset calibration screen
The ?auto bot hit all 907 notes of the last song perfectly for an S grade, with and without assets
61 fps (display cap) on an Intel UHD GPU at 1280x720 with 29 draw calls; one index.html, optional CC0 asset pass
